name: Cuyahoga Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Out-of-state/non-resident rate $306.19 per credit hour (Summer/Fall 2026 tuition & fees from tri-c.edu tuition-and-fees page: $120.04 instructional + $19.50 general/tech + $166.65 out-of-state surcharge). Annualized at 30 credit hours/yr to match the in-state $4,186 basis (in-county $139.54/cr x 30 = $4,186); $306.19 x 30 = $9,186.
